description: morcellated myomectomy, cellular leiomyoma, mitoses counted
report:
Uterus, fibroid, morcellated myomectomy

Received in formalin are multiple morcellated fragments of firm whitish tissue, weighing 120 g and measuring 10 x 8 x 5 cm in aggregate. The fragments measure from 1 to 5 cm across. Sectioning shows a whorled cut surface. No fleshy area or necrosis is identified. Representative sections in 4 blocks.

(1-4) Representative fragments.

Sections show pieces of smooth muscle tumour tissue comprising spindle cells arranged in fascicles and whorls. Thick walled vessels are seen. Mitoses number 2 per 10 HPF. While the tumour cellularity is high, no epithelioid tumour cells, significant nuclear atypia, or coagulative tumour necrosis are observed. There is no evidence of malignancy. Features are those of cellular leiomyoma. Fragments of unremarkable myometrium are also present.

UTERUS, fibroid, morcellated myomectomy - CELLULAR LEIOMYOMA

Fragmentation of the morcellated specimen precludes assessment of the tumour border and the serosa.
